name: Vase
dimensions: Height 50.5 cm; Width 9.3 cm; Diameter 8.3 cm
summary: This vase with two lugs on both sides of the mouth is called a 'tou hu' ( 'pitch pot'). It was used in a game which started in China in the 6th century BC and involved throwing arrows into a pot. Different scores were awarded to the player depending on whether the arrows landed in the wider mouth op
